node.statement: Because W is nonempty, C=conv{p_w:w in W} is a nonempty compact convex subset of finite-dimensional l1 space. Since v is a hidden top vertex of height H, H=dist_1(p_v,C). The l1/l_infty distance duality formula gives u with ||u||_inf<=1 such that u.p_v - sup_{c in C} u.c = H; with b=-sup_C u.c and phi(x)=u.x+b, we have phi<=0 on C and phi(p_v)=H.
